proved_step: LEMMA (identity, bookkeeping): for any CNF F on n variables with clauses C_1..C_m, #F = sum over S subset of {1..m} of (-1)^|S| * 2^(n-|V(S)|) * [S consistent]. Proof: [x sat F] = prod_i (1 - [x falsifies C_i]); expand; each product of falsification indicators over S equals [x falsifies every clause of S], whose sum over x in {0,1}^n is 2^(n-|V(S)|) if S is consistent and 0 otherwise. Evidence: cm-b4aa92c386b14b14 (VERIFICATION, 400 random CNFs, 0 mismatches). Note: bookkeeping identity, not progress toward P vs NP.

LEMMA (matrix core of the T1 Hadamard lemma, S-c04b3d909c): for any field F (in particular GF(p)) and any a x b matrices A, B over F, rank(A o B) <= rank(A) * rank(B), where o is the entrywise product. Proof: write A = U V^T with U a x rA, V b x rA (rank factorisation), and B = X Y^T with X a x rB, Y b x rB. Then (A o B)_{ij} = sum_{k,l} (U_{ik} X_{il}) (V_{jk} Y_{jl}), so A o B = sum_{k,l} (U_k o X_l)(V_k o Y_l)^T, a sum of rA*rB rank-one matrices. Consequence: for functions f, g: {0,1}^n -> F with cut matrices M_i(f), M_i(g), the cut matrix of f*g is M_i(f) o M_i(g), so cut rank(fg) <= cut rank(f) * cut rank(g). Evidence: cm-0114904a9c1e4f47 (VERIFICATION, own GF(p) elimination, p in {2,3,5}, 3000 random pairs each, violations of product bound 0/0/0; competing max bound violated 22/18/14 times). Scope: all fields, all dimensions. Note: this is a classical Schur-product rank inequality; the record is a reproduction and a bookkeeping step, not progress on P vs NP.

proved_step: CLAIMED (proof attempt, not reviewed) LEMMA S-6ce27138d2, two-sweep form. Setting: field GF(p); cores G_k[b] of size r_{k-1} x r_k (b in {0,1}), r_0 = r_n = 1, f(x) = G_1[x_1]...G_n[x_n] nonzero; M_k(f) = 2^k x 2^(n-k) cut matrix; c_k = rank M_k(f). Statement: after one L->R sweep (step k: rref U_k of the unfolding U with rows (a,b) = G_k[b][a], U_k = B_k R_k, set G_k[b] := rows of B_k, G_{k+1}[b] := R_k G_{k+1}[b]) and one R->L sweep (mirror image), the bond dims equal c_k for 1<=k<=n-1 and f is unchanged. Proof: (i) Each elimination step preserves f: new G_k[b] R_k G_{k+1} = U_b G_{k+1} = G_k[b] G_{k+1} because U = B R. (ii) Invariant after the L->R sweep: the prefix matrix P_k(x_1..x_k) = G_1[x_1]...G_k[x_k] (2^k x s_k) has full column rank s_k, by induction (the pivot columns of U_k are independent, so B_k has full column rank, and P_{k-1} full column rank is preserved under the map induced by B_k). Hence M_k(f) = P_k S_k gives rank M_k = rank S_k <= s_k. (iii) The R->L sweep at bond k is the mirror image of step (i), so it fixes the new bond dim as the rank of the current suffix matrix; this rank equals c_k because the L->R invariant (ii) makes the suffix rank equal the cut rank. (iv) Full column rank of the prefix (ii) is restored at bond k after step k+1 of the R->L sweep, since that step only multiplies core k by an r_k x s'_k matrix whose columns are independent (pivot columns), so P_k A keeps full column rank s'_k = c_k. Hence bond k dimension = c_k.
